# Free Society Hack

> A Zcash hackathon with a Bitrefill track, solo or in teams of up to 4, Mumbai, Wed 4 – Thu 5 Nov 2026 (IST, UTC+5:30), during Devcon week. Load only the track file you need: each one is self-contained.

## Pick your track

- [Privacy track (Zcash)]({{ORIGIN}}/programs/free-society-hack-2026/privacy/llms.txt): build private money on Zcash. Testnet only, shielded payments, no real money.
- [Agentic Commerce track (Bitrefill)]({{ORIGIN}}/programs/free-society-hack-2026/agentic-commerce/llms.txt): an agent that finds, buys and pays through Bitrefill on its own. Real purchases with event credits.
- Entering both: load both files and meet both sets of requirements. The two tracks have different money rules (testnet vs real), so keep each track's rules to its own part of the project.

## Start (paste into your coding agent)

- Privacy: `Read {{ORIGIN}}/programs/free-society-hack-2026/privacy/llms.txt, save it as AGENTS.md in a new repo, then scaffold the smallest version of my idea that makes one real shielded testnet payment.`
- Agentic Commerce: `Read {{ORIGIN}}/programs/free-society-hack-2026/agentic-commerce/llms.txt, save it as AGENTS.md in a new repo, then scaffold the smallest version of my idea with a spend cap before any purchase.`

Save the file once into the repo (AGENTS.md or CLAUDE.md) so your agent reads it locally instead of fetching it every turn.

## Key times

- Wed 4 Nov 11:00: hacking starts. All code is made at the hack: new repo on the day.
- Wed 4 Nov 20:00: click **Finalize and submit** on Stadium to be in the first judging round (~20:30). Save drafts before that as often as you like (only your team sees them); drafts are not judged. The point person starts the submission and can give teammates edit access; the event feedback must be submitted before finalizing.
- Thu 5 Nov 00:00: submissions close. A finalized submission stays editable until then; code after 00:00 isn't scored.
- Thu 5 Nov 08:00: morning judging.
- Thu 5 Nov 11:00: top teams announced to demo.
- Thu 5 Nov 11:30: demos.
- Thu 5 Nov 13:00: prize announcements.

## Help

- Mentors at the venue (True Tramm Trunk, BKC) and the mentors chat: https://t.me/+QHbTGB6jFhllMDk6
